channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Ciyaaryahanka Ravens Marlon Humphrey oo raali-gelin ka bixiyay hadal uu ka sheegay magaalada Baltimore
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka khadka daafaca ee Baltimore Ravens Marlon Humphrey ayaa Arbacadii raali-gelin bixiyay, kaddib markii uu barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ku sheegay in Baltimore ay ugu fiican tahay soo saarista dambiilayaal, sida ay wariyeen CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.

item.title: Mareykanka oo cunaqabateyn cusub saaray urur uu ku tilmaamay waji u ah Xisbullah
item.description: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii cunaqabateyn saartay ururka Wa Ta'awanu Association ee Lubnaan, oo ay ku tilmaantay waji ay Xisbullah u adeegsato ururinta lacagaha, iyo saddex qof oo Lubnaan ku nool, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Muddadii is-diiwaangelinta doorashada madaxtooyada FIFA oo xirantay, Infantino oo ah musharaxa ugu horreeya
item.description: Muddadii musharaxiinta doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA ayaa xirantay, iyadoo Gianni Infantino uu yahay musharaxa loo badinayo inuu ku guuleysto shirweynaha 18 March ee Rabat, halka Philippe Diallo iyo Kozo Tashima ay iyana tartamayaan, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Luke Littler oo laga reebay Grand Slam of Darts kaddib guuldaro 10-8 ah oo uu ka soo gaaray Jermaine Wattimena
item.description: Horyaalkii difaacanayay Luke Littler ayaa si lama filaan ah looga saaray Grand Slam of Darts ee Wolverhampton, kaddib markii ciyaaryahanka reer Holland Jermaine Wattimena uu 10-8 kaga adkaaday wareegga labaad, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Manchester United oo tixgelinaysa tallaabo sharci ah kaddib bixitaanka JJ Gabriel ee Real Madrid
item.description: Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay diyaar u tahay inay tallaabo sharci ah qaaddo haddii ay hesho caddeyn muujinaysa in kooxo kale ay la xiriireen ciyaaryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel intii uu heshiiska kula jiray, sida ay wariyeen warbaahinta Ingiriiska iyo Spain.

item.title: Juventus Haweenka oo 2-0 ku garaacday OH Leuven, una gudubtay wareegga ka-saarista Champions League
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Juventus ayaa Arbacadii magaalada Biella 2-0 kaga adkaatay OH Leuven ee Belgium ciyaartii 5aad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League, waxayna xaqiijisay inay u gudubto wareegga ka-saarista iyadoo ay ka harsan tahay hal ciyaar.

item.title: Mamadou Coulibaly oo hal kulan laga mamnuucay kaddib dabaaldeggiisii muranka dhaliyay
item.description: Guddiga anshaxa ee Ligue de Football Professionnel (LFP) ayaa Arbacadii hal kulan oo toos ah iyo laba kulan oo shuruud ah ku ganaaxay ciyaaryahanka Monaco Mamadou Coulibaly, kaddib dabaaldeg uu sameeyay markii uu gool ka dhaliyay Le Mans.

item.title: Rob Manfred: milkiilayaasha MLB ma aqbali doonaan heshiis aan lahayn xad mushahar
item.description: Guddoomiyaha horyaalka baseball-ka Mareykanka (MLB) Rob Manfred ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in milkiilayaasha kooxaha aysan ka tanaasuli doonin dalabkooda ah in heshiiska shaqada ee cusub uu yeesho xad sare iyo xad hoose oo mushaharka ah, taas oo horyaalka u dhaweynaysa xannibaad shaqo.

item.title: Wadaad ku nool Florida oo lagu helay dembiyo la xiriira dilkii Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse
item.description: Xeerbeegti federaal ah oo ku sugan Miami ayaa Arbacadii dembi ku heshay wadaadka Christian Emmanuel Sanon, oo haysta dhalashada Haiti iyo Mareykanka, dhammaan sideed eedeyn oo ay ka mid tahay shirqool lagu dilayay Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse, sida ay wariyeen CBS News iyo CNN.

item.title: Chelsea oo gool dambe 1-0 kaga adkaatay PSG, kuna gashay hoggaanka Champions League-ka Haweenka
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Chelsea ayaa Arbacadii 1-0 kaga adkaatay Paris Saint-Germain wareegga horyaalka ee UEFA Women's Champions League, kaddib gool ay daqiiqadii 88 dhalisay daafaca Veerle Buurman.

item.title: Copa del Rey: Mallorca oo waqti dheeraad ah ku dhaaftay Alcoyano, Tenerife-na 5-2 ku garaacday Badajoz
item.description: Mallorca ayaa Arbacadii 3-1 kaga adkaatay Alcoyano kaddib waqti dheeraad ah, halka Tenerife ay 5-2 kaga badisay Badajoz, iyagoo labaduba u gudbay wareegga xiga ee Copa del Rey.

item.title: Mykhailo Mudryk oo sheegay in maamulka xulka Ukraine uu mas'uul ka yahay baaritaankii doping-ka ee uu ku dhacay
item.description: Weeraryahanka Tottenham ee amaahda kaga jira Chelsea, Mykhailo Mudryk, ayaa markii ugu horreysay si furan uga hadlay ganaaxiisii doping-ka, isagoo eedda saaray maamulka xulka qaranka Ukraine, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo AS.

item.title: Daafaca England Jess Carter oo ku biirtay Bay FC kaddib markii ay ka tagtay Gotham FC
item.description: Ciyaaryahanadda khadka daafaca ee xulka England Jess Carter ayaa u wareegtay kooxda Bay FC ee horyaalka NWSL, iyadoo heshiis la saxiixatay ilaa 2028 kaddib markii ay si xor ah uga tagtay Gotham FC, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Strasbourg oo si rasmi ah u magacaabtay Vítor Matos, Hugo Oliveira-na wuu tagay
item.description: Kooxda Strasbourg ee Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in Vítor Matos oo 38 jir ah, kana yimid Swansea City, uu noqday tababarahooda cusub, kaddib markii ay kala tageen Hugo Oliveira.

item.title: Sonny Gray oo ku laabtay Minnesota Twins, heshiis laba sano ah oo lagu sheegay 55 milyan oo dollar
item.description: Kooxda baseball-ka Minnesota Twins ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay dib u qaadatay tuuraha waayo-aragga ah Sonny Gray, iyadoo heshiiska lagu sheegay laba sano iyo 55 milyan oo dollar, sida ay werisay CBS Sports.

item.title: Pew: Islaamku wuxuu 2035 ka gudbi doonaa Masiixiyadda, noqonna doonaa diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka
item.description: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baarista Pew Research Center ayaa saadaalisay in Islaamku uu sannadka 2035 ka gudbi doono Masiixiyadda, uuna noqon doono diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka.

item.title: Valtteri Bottas oo kursigiisa Cadillac ku sii haynaya xilli ciyaareedka 2027
item.description: Darawalka Finland u dhashay Valtteri Bottas ayaa sii wadi doona inuu u wado kooxda Mareykanka ee Cadillac xilli ciyaareedka 2027 ee Formula 1, kaddib muddo mustaqbalkiisa uu ahaa mid aan la hubin.

item.title: McKennie oo sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay Juventus, hadalkiisa Man Utd-na si khaldan loo fahmay
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Juventus iyo xulka Mareykanka, Weston McKennie, ayaa sheegay in hadalladii uu dhowaan ka sheegay Manchester United si khaldan loo fahmay, isla markaana uu ku faraxsan yahay inuu sii joogo Juventus.

item.title: Real Madrid oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter, Signe Bruun oo laba gool dhalisay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Real Madrid ayaa Arbacadii garoonka Alfredo Di Stéfano 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter Milan, kulan ka tirsan Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Signe Bruun ay daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay dhalisay laba gool.

item.title: Manchester City oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Häcken, Hemp iyo Shaw oo dhaliyay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Manchester City ayaa Arbacadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay BK Häcken oo dalka Sweden ah, kulan ka tirsan wareegga horyaalka Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Lauren Hemp iyo Khadija Shaw ay dhaliyeen goolasha.

item.title: Leicester City oo joojisay heshiiska maalgeliyaha funaanadda BC Game
item.description: Kooxda Leicester City ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay heshiis ku kala tageen shirkadda sharadka internetka ee BC Game, oo funaanaddooda ku qornayd tan iyo 2024, kaddib cabashooyin ka yimid taageerayaasha.

item.title: Rassie Erasmus oo la ganaaxay 6 kulan, kulanka Ireland-na toos ula daawan doona taageerayaasha
item.description: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, oo World Rugby ay 6 kulan ka mamnuucday hoggaaminta Springboks, ayaa qorsheynaya inuu kulanka Ireland ee Sabtida si toos ah internetka ugula daawado taageerayaasha.

item.title: Darajada FIFA: Spain oo hoggaanka haysa, Morocco-na markii ugu horreysay 5-ta sare gashay
item.description: Darajada cusub ee FIFA oo Arbacadii la shaaciyay ayaa Spain ku sii haysa kaalinta 1-aad, Argentina 2-aad iyo Faransiiska 3-aad, halka Morocco ay gashay 5-ta xul ee ugu sarreysa, kana sarreysay Brazil.

item.title: Primož Roglič oo ku biiray kooxda baaskiilka NSN ee Andrés Iniesta
item.description: Baaskiil-wadaha Slovenia u dhashay Primož Roglič oo 37 jir ah ayaa ka tagay Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, wuxuuna heshiis hal sano ah la saxiixday kooxda NSN Cycling, oo uu milkiilayaasheeda ka mid yahay ciyaaryahankii hore ee Spain Andrés Iniesta.

item.title: Sharciga offside-ka ee Wenger oo la filayo in la tuuro kaddib tijaabo Canada
item.description: Sharciga cusub ee offside-ka oo uu soo jeediyay Arsène Wenger, laguna tijaabiyay horyaalka Canada tan iyo bishii April, ayaa la filayaa in aan la dhaqan gelin, sida ay werisay L'Équipe iyadoo soo xiganaysa The New York Times.

item.title: SU’AALO CULUS OO KA DHASHAY KULANKA MUUNGAAB IYO DIBLOMAASIYIINTA IMAARAADKA EE NAIROBI!
item.description: Maxaa ka dambeeyay kulanka qarsoodiga ah ee Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, uu la yeeshay saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta?

item.title: Kadaga: Uganda kaligeed ma qaadi karto culayska qaxootiga taageero caalami ah la'aanteed
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Uganda, Rebecca Alitwala Kadaga, ayaa Arbacadii ka digtay in siyaasadda albaabka furan ee dalkeeda aan loo fahmin awood aan xad lahayn, waxayna ku baaqday taageero caalami ah oo badan.

item.title: Walter Samuel oo sagootiyay xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ka mid ahaa shaqaalaha Scaloni
item.description: Difaacii hore ee Roma iyo Inter Walter Samuel ayaa si rasmi ah uga tagay shaqaalaha tababarka xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ku garab shaqaynayay Lionel Scaloni, sida uu xulku ku shaaciyay baraha bulshada, una werisay Sky Sport Italia.

item.title: Maamulaha Juventus Carnevali: Khaladaad ayaa dhacay, dib-u-dhiska waqti ayuu u baahan yahay
item.description: Agaasimaha guud ee Juventus, Giovanni Carnevali, ayaa qirtay in kooxda ay sannadihii la soo dhaafay gashay khaladaad, isla markaana sheegay in heshiiska maaliyadeed ee ay UEFA la leedahay uu xaddidayo awoodda ay ku iibsan karto ciyaartoy.

item.title: Doorashada FIFA: Tashima oo doonaya wadahadal la yeesho Diallo, DFB-na si rasmi ah u taageertay Diallo
item.description: Kozo Tashima oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha FIFA ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu wadahadal la yeesho Philippe Diallo, oo isna u tartamaya xilka, halka Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Jarmalka uu si rasmi ah u taageeray Diallo.
